summary: Iter 44 — backend-only validation of NEW endpoints (ollama-status, duplicate, share enable/disable, public /share/{slug} + preview, cascade-chat resilience, GitHub export to Ph1nt0m-oss/save). 11/11 pytest cases pass on the live preview URL with credentials test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com / Pass1234.

minor.issue: ProjectCreate model does not accept generated_code even though Project model carries it; clients must POST then PUT in two calls. Minor DX inconsistency — not a blocker.

action_items: (Optional) Extend ProjectCreate to accept generated_code at creation time so seeding/import flows can be single-shot.
(Optional) server.py still 5049 lines — split into routers (projects, share, system) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: duplicate_project (server.py L3690): correctly resets share_slug=None and is_public=False on clone, generates new uuid, suffixes name with '(copie)' and truncates to 80 chars — clean.

toggle_project_share: when disabling, slug is NOT cleared in DB (only is_public flipped). Response correctly returns slug:null, but the document keeps the old share_slug, which is reused on re-enable. Acceptable behaviour (stable slugs across toggles) but worth documenting.
get_public_share strips user_id and ai_source via Mongo projection — sensitive fields properly hidden. Verified absent in payload.
get_public_share_preview returns 404 HTMLResponse correctly for unknown slugs; content-type text/html confirmed.
ollama_status uses a 1.5s httpx timeout and a broad except — fine for a probe endpoint, won't block UI.
Cascade chat with model='inexistant' transparently fell back to emergent:openai:gpt-5.2 — no 500 surfaced, ai_response.content='OK'. Silent cascade works as designed.
test_credentials: test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com / Pass1234 — login OK, session_token returned.
